newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle prices trade $1-$2 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle prices trade $1-$2 lower - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers 1.00 to fully 2.00 lower. Inquiry and demand uneven. Buyers lowered their bids dramatically through the day.
Seller interest fairly good. Sales Confirmed: 14,200 Last Week: 14,600 Last Year: 6,800 Week To Date: 55,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk:75,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr:25,400
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs 70.00-71.00, few to 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs 70.00-71.00, few to 69.00.
Dressed Basis Delivered. Steers and heifers 1.00 to fully 2.00 lower for the second consecutive day.
Dressed Basis Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 115.00-116.00; some early carrying larger percentage Choice to 118.00; some predominately Select 113.00-114.00. ( weighted average 115.35 )

Dressed Basis Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 115.00-116.00; some early carrying larger percentage Choice to 118.00; several pens predominately Select 113.00-114.00. ( weighted average 115.12 )
